class.sporeadd.kommandant.description:
§6How to obtain:§r When an infected hits a player within a protobrain's radius, that player gains the §aCall of the Hive§r effect with a %2$s%% chance. Dying with that effect offers the choice to join the infection.

The §4Kommandant§r is an infected adventurer who kept their individuality after surrendering to the spore. Their goal is to spread the infection and eradicate all opposition by whatever means necesary.

§8§lPASSIVES§r

§6§lBiomass & Evolution§r
Killing entities, eating §4Biomass Bulbs§r, §4Remains§r or raw §4Biomass§r, and devouring weaker infected all raise biomass. With enough biomass and resources a Kommandant evolves dangerously fast, unlocking new abilities and mutating into different variants along the way.

§6§lMounds§r
Place §4Mounds§r to set respawn points and travel quickly between them (on death without avalible mounds remaining it will become permadeath depending on the configuration of the server).

§6§lHardened Body§r
At high evolution levels the Kommandant becomes highly resistant to damage.

§8§lACTIVES§r

§6§lAbility Selector§r
Open your abilities with %1$s. Reading §6Skill 2§r there is essential: it lists exactly what is needed to gather evolution resources. Each evolution ability can also be bound to its own key in Controls, under the Spore Add category.

§6§lBiomass Core§r
Craft and use a §4Biomass Core§r to mold it into a living weapon or tool suited to the moment.

§6§lHunter Tools§r
At high levels the Kommandant unlocks abilities to detect other adventurers and hunt them down in unpredictable ways.
class.sporeadd.ghost.description:
The §aGhost§r is a stealth class built to eliminate spore infected quickly and quietly, without ever being noticed.

§8§lPASSIVES§r

§6§lBackstab§r
With a weapon in hand, striking a non-player entity from behind executes it outright if the hit would leave it below 20 hp. A one-blow kill this way does not alert its allies, letting a skilled user clear a whole group without breaking cover.

§6§lBucket of Remains§r
Only the Ghost can use it. Pouring it makes the user seen as an ally to common spore infected for a short time.

§8§lACTIVES§r

Open the §6Action Wheel§r with %1$s to use the two Ghost skills.

§6§lDisguise§r
Turns the Ghost completely invisible, armor and items included, free to move and jump while a visible bush disguise remains that other players might still spot. Mobs cannot detect a disguised Ghost unless touched or attacked. While disguised, backstab rises from x2 to §ax3§r and applies §cCritical Wound§r (§c-30%%§r movement speed, §c-40%%§r damage dealt, 30s), and ranged damage gains §a+50%%§r. Recast to cancel; 20s cooldown. Taking damage breaks it instantly, and if it came from an entity the Ghost is left §cAmbushed§r for 10s: sharply reduced own speed and damage, and doubled incoming damage.

§6§lDecoy§r
Summons a bush decoy at the Ghost's position. If a disguised Ghost is detected by a mob within 20 blocks of an active decoy, the mob targets the decoy instead. Any hit destroys a decoy on impact, and a melee attacker that attacks one is left heavily §cPoisoned§r for 30s. Up to 20 decoys can exist at once.
class.sporeadd.medic.description:
The §cMedic§r is a support class built around healing allies and clearing negative effects.

§8§lPASSIVES§r

§6§lGas Mask§r
A permanent, unremovable mask granting §a+4 armor§r and §a+3 armor toughness§r, at the cost of being noticeably weaker in direct combat.

§6§lTriage§r
Sees any entity within 32 blocks below 90%% hp through walls, colour-coded by how hurt it is.

§6§lInjector§r
The Medic's starting tool. Open the §6Action Wheel§r with %1$s to pick which effect it applies, then use it on an ally.

§6§lThrowable Bandages§r
Craftable from a single wool. Thrown to heal teammates at range, or used while crouching to heal yourself.

§6§lSyringe & Vaccine§r
Only a Medic can use the §bSyringe§r to draw blood from themselves or another player, then develop it in the 3D printer's §bCentrifugator§r into a §bVaccine§r that cures §cTermina§r. Each vaccine is unique to the exact player and infection instance it was drawn from.

§8§lACTIVES§r

Two more skills sit on the Action Wheel.

§6§lDefibrillate§r
Targets the lowest-hp non-spore entity within 4 blocks and marks it with sparks. If that entity would die, a shockwave instead deals 40 damage in a 3-block radius and fully heals it, leaving §cPostmortem§r for 150s (§c-5§r attack damage, §c-40%%§r speed and movement). 80s cooldown.

§6§lSelf Defibrillate§r
Appears only below 30%% hp. A last-resort gamble: find the one real icon among 75 fakes within 3s, taking §a-80%%§r damage while the minigame runs. Success casts Defibrillate on yourself. Failing the timer, clicking a wrong icon, or dying to something else fires the shockwave on you as you die. If a spore infected hit you shortly before that death, you instead become a §cConductor§r infected, keeping your armor and 60s of delayed defibrillation.
class.sporeadd.scientist.description:
The §bScientist§r is a support class focused on researching the infection to build tools and weapons against it. Most of their gear relies on research progress, gathered at the §bResearch Unit§r by feeding it frozen biomass.

§8§lPASSIVES§r

§6§lScalpel§r
Starting weapon. Low damage, but unlocks Data from spore infected: §b1 Data§r per hit, §b10 Data§r per kill.

§6§lResearch Gear§r
Exclusive to the Scientist: the §bImprovised Locator§r (burns redstone to pin a Kommandant's position), the §bCore Mound Locator§r (reveals every core mound a Kommandant could respawn at), the §bProto Locator§r (portable upgraded Zoaholic, finds every protohive within 10,000 blocks), the §bNano Injector§r (freezes spore entities and applies §cVulnerable§r, §c+25%%§r incoming damage), the §bSurgical Implantator§r (apply implants to self or others), and the §bUltra Freezer§r (a far stronger C.D.U. that demands more maintenance but doesn't need resources to be active).

§8§lACTIVES§r

Open the §6Action Wheel§r with %1$s to use the two Scientist skills.

§6§lField Research§r
A living record of every spore entity killed, the Data gathered, and the upgrades earned. An entity becomes §6Prestiged§r once enough kills and Data are logged:
§8Rarity 1: §r20 kills / 500 Data
§8Rarity 2: §r10 kills / 250 Data
§8Rarity 3: §r5 kills / 125 Data
§8Rarity 4: §r2 kills / 50 Data
Opens any time, no cooldown.

§6§lExpose Weakness§r
Scans a 32-block radius, but only affects entities you have personally killed at least once. Anything caught gains §cExposed Weakness§r: weak points that deal bonus damage scaled by the total Data of every Scientist on the server (soft-capped every 200 Data, max §a+20§r). Killing a Prestiged entity through a weak point doubles its loot. 15s cooldown.
class.sporeadd.berserker.description:
The §6Berserker§r is a combat class built for taking down strong opponents while preventing them from escaping, makes use of controlled dosage of infected blood samples to inherit their attributes while agitated.

§8§lPASSIVES§r

§6§lReinforced Combat Chains§r
A strong tactic only a Berserker can use, thrown from the offhand. When the chains hit a target, owner and target become §cEnchained§r and cannot move more than 15 blocks apart. Enchained players deal §c-15%%§r damage and non-player entities §c-65%%§r, and neither can use ender pearls or glide with elytra. Whoever has the higher health and pull strength drags the other. The chains lose 1 durability per second while active; the link breaks when they run out of durability, one entity dies, the owner swaps the item out of the offhand, or the two end up over 80 blocks apart which can only occur when a extreme external force separates them.

§8§lACTIVES§r

Open the §6Action Wheel§r with %1$s to use the three Berserker skills.

§6§lCounter§r
Braces for a heartbeat: for 0.5s, or until the first incoming hit from an entity, the next attack is fully negated. A melee hit sends §a50%%§r of its damage back to the attacker; a projectile is thrown back at its shooter at the same speed. If nothing connects it enters a 5s cooldown; if it repels something the cooldown equals a quarter of that hit's damage in seconds.

§6§lClaws of Brutality§r
A meter on the side of the screen fills with damage you actually deal to other creatures (overkill excluded); after 20s without a hit it starts to wear off. At §6200§r you can activate it: bone claws sprout over both hands and every §obare-handed§r strike deals a flat §c12§r damage, boosted further by critical hits, while the meter drains on its own. When it empties the claws retract and the skill enters a 120s cooldown. Holding a weapon gives no bonus.

§6§lCompounds§r
Opens a personal 6-slot kit. Each slot holds one §bsyringe§r that grants a stackable effect while Claws of Brutality is active; a syringe's tooltip explains its effect when held by a Berserker.
